description.value: Baan Lao Fine Thai Cuisine is an acclaimed fine-dining restaurant in Steveston, Richmond, ranked #12 on North America's 50 Best Restaurants list and winner of the Best Destination Restaurant Award 2025. Led by Executive Chef and Proprietor Nutcha Phanthoupheng, the restaurant offers a seasonally changing multi-course Royal Thai tasting menu and the world's first sommelier-led Afternoon Thai Tea Experience. Cyclists visiting the Steveston waterfront area will find this an exceptional special-occasion dining destination.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 15m; rack at 57m; rack at 86m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website corroborates the OSM name, address (4100 Bayview Street, Richmond, BC), and phone (778 839 5711). The site confirms the business is open and active, with 2025 award mentions and current menus. The FAQ page provides explicit dietary accommodation information, and the shop page references 'Baan Lao To Go order,' confirming takeout exists.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (Fr-Su 12:30-22:00; We-Th 17:00-22:00) partially conflicts with website, which shows the 12:30 pm service is Thai Tea only on Saturdays and Sundays, while Friday dinner begins at 5 pm — website should be treated as authoritative.
Website lists an email address (info@baanlao.ca) not present in the OSM record.
Restaurant requires reservations, operates set-price tasting menus only with a 2.5-hour dining experience and smart casual dress code — cycling attire may not meet the dress code requirement.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, and publicly accessible fine-dining restaurant in Steveston with an active website and confirmed contact details. A noteworthy destination for cyclists exploring the Richmond/Steveston waterfront.
enrichment_extras.notes: Vegetarian and vegan diners cannot be accommodated per the FAQ; gluten-free and dairy-free guests can be. The restaurant grows and sells its own organic rice.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ confirms gluten-free and dairy-free accommodations are available. However, FAQ explicitly states: 'We are currently unable to accommodate requests for: Vegetarian-Vegan.'
